name: Ōsumi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ōsumi town emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised arrowhead.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōsumi in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-07-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 January 1965.

features.role: Ōsumi town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised arrowhead
